archetypes.name: voter-contract
archetypes.rationale: The port must preserve exact voter KV and retry semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python voter dispatcher against the retired Bash contract implied by the tests and docs. Focus on shrink-not-backfill sizing, tool-name output mapping, sentinel timing, parse-rate retry arguments, and stdout cleanliness. Flag any drift that could break review-core or tally parsing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: stub-root
archetypes.rationale: Child CLI root resolution is load-bearing for installed plugins and harnesses.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check every child CLI invocation and parse-rate plugin-root handoff. Verify CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is honored consistently and no late subprocess path falls back to the checkout when a stub plugin root is configured. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
